operator_observations.scope: first attempt, about six seconds after Ready, preceding A5 speed trip

deployment.persistence_evidence: Saved setup, subsequent fresh-MCU setup readback with zero lock/masks and all target ranges, then passing full-profile disabled check. Physical supply switching was operator-performed, not directly observed by agent.

attempt_1.outcome: A5 speed fault during fixed Ready hold; operator confirms untouched

attempt_2.outcome: Ready, continuous welding, intent pause, then verified disable and mode restoration; no further fault
attempt_2.stop_reason: Operator intent interrupted; existing arm hold retained; recalculate.

data_quality.notes: Full JSONL retains both attempts; bounded embedded motor sample list dropped 6000 earlier rows. Stage statistics use fresh enabled cached JSONL samples, not the truncated embedded sample list.

limitations: Torque is drive-reported feedback, not independently calibrated shaft torque.
Statistics are sample-weighted; gaps and rejected samples remain explicit.
Match physical start, route, settings, support contact and temperatures before attributing changes to payload.
An open journal has no final shutdown result; summary does not stop or contact the motor owner.
Drive-reported motor temperature is not an independent winding thermometer.
Moving command-error statistics compare lead-corrected commands; nominal-reference errors governing the 3-degree trip are reported separately.
The two attempts had different measured starts and materially different torque signatures, even at identical Ready targets; load/contact/mechanical-state cause is not established.
Requested 15-second Ready recording and 5-10 second preparation goal are not met in attempt 2.
A1/A6 final-window travel exceeds plan; matching Hz does not qualify weave amplitude or tool-path accuracy.
